summary: The exact candidate is valid test-only hardening. The recorded base already contains the source fix: MiniMax-M3 resolves properties beneath a root-only oneOf through get_schema_properties(). The candidate's exact three-call streaming regression passes on current source and fails with the reported wrong types and raw tags under an independently applied legacy lookup. Independent character-split streaming and non-stream numeric-array cases also pass.

tests.what_was_measured: Actual prepared base parser suite: 24 passed and 14 subtests passed; imports resolved to repository source.
Candidate regression and focused suite: 26 passed and 16 subtests passed, including the exact number/string-array/number-array stream.
Independent failing-before simulation at the parser lookup site reproduced number as string '42' and arrays containing raw MiniMax item tags.

Character-by-character streaming and non-stream decimal/numeric-array cases passed; the final adversarial root-properties-plus-oneOf case intentionally exposed a remaining broader counterexample, returning '3.5' as a string.

gpu_evidence: One assigned AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 was available, but this deterministic Python parser path executes no GPU kernels.
remaining_counterexamples: A legal schema containing both root properties and root oneOf does not resolve branch-only properties: a branch number value 3.5 is emitted as string '3.5' because get_schema_properties() returns early when root properties exists. This is broader than the original root-only oneOf report.
remaining_limitations: The official reproduction requests TP=4 but only one gfx950 GPU was assigned; no full-model server, official HTTP verifier, semantic-accuracy, or distributed reproduction is claimed.
The deterministic tiny Llama fixture cannot qualify MiniMax-M3 architecture output and was not used.
The candidate changes no native code and repository-environment.json reports native null, so no native rebuild was applicable.
